_doc: Map representations of playable locations. A map is a game artefact, not geography: 'representation' says whether its layout depicts real streets or is invented. A playable location without a map is not enterable yet. Milestone 1 only records the existing map; it does not change how the game loads it.

maps.description: The current game world: an invented street with four invented buildings (Mercearia Girassol, Casa Mussulo, Escritório Atlântico, Restaurante Maianga), labelled 'Rua · Maianga'. It does not reproduce any real street, building or landmark of Maianga. Building names are game names, not real businesses.
